$Comment: What the members of the Great Turkey's fight see as it rises and the fight begins: a big banner, its
line and, under it, what the fight is for. Its binding row points its Engaged beat here
lines in this pack's harvestfeast.progression.lang, written bare.
The moment fires once per member. The banner always reaches the members (ToParticipants) and anyone
else standing within RadiusBlocks of them, which keeps it inside this one graveyard: the graveyards of
one copy share a world but stand far further apart than this. MinSecondsBetween folds the members'
fires into one banner, and stays short so it never swallows another party's banner in the same copy.
